[00:26] Oaspete (Ayse Ozgen): Hi, thank you so much for the warm welcome!

We have a small question. When we made the reservation, the check-in time was shown as 13:00, which is why we booked this place. Now we see it's 15:00, and unfortunately we won't have anywhere to leave our luggage for a few hours.

Would it be possible for us to come at 13:00 just to drop off our suitcases? We don't need the apartment to be ready — we'll leave right after and come back later in the evening.

Thank you very much for your understanding!
